newsitem.title: USA: Synthetic Industries issues $170 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Synthetic Industries issues $170 mln debt.

text.p: The following high-yield debt issue from Synthetic Industries Inc was priced late on Thursday, according to a market source.
The issue was increased in size by $45 million.
Bear, Stearns & Co was lead manager on the deal.
